# Vetta 0.6.16
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-23 -->

## English

### New

- New Settings → Usage page: see how many tokens you used today, this week or over a longer range, broken down by day and by model, with counts shown in K, M and B.
- Turn any range on the Usage page into a boarding-pass style ticket image to save or share. It carries the Vetta logo and keeps the same look in light and dark themes.

### Fixes

- The doodle texture on the new-session and chat pages now fills the whole window after opening or resizing the activity panel or resizing the window.

## 中文

### 新增

- 设置新增「用量」页：查看今天、本周或更长时段用了多少 token，按天和按模型分开统计，数量以 K、M、B 显示。
- 用量页可把所选时段做成一张登机牌式小票图片，方便保存或分享；小票带 Vetta 图标，深浅色主题下样子一致。

### 修复

- 新会话页和对话页的涂鸦纹理在开关或拖宽活动面板、缩放窗口后会重新铺满整页，不再右侧留白。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.15...v0.6.16
